arxiv-1801-09536.title: A Survey of Word Embeddings Evaluation Methods
arxiv-1801-09536.creator: Amir Bakarov
arxiv-1801-09536.description: Abstract Word embeddings are real-valued word representations able to capture lexical semantics and trained on natural language corpora. Models proposing these representations have gained popularity in the recent years, but the issue of the most adequate evaluation method still remains open.

arxiv-2107-11939.title: Relaxed Indexability and Index Policy for Partially Observable Restless Bandits
arxiv-2107-11939.creator: Keqin Liu
arxiv-2107-11939.description: Abstract This paper addresses an important class of restless multi-armed bandit (RMAB) problems that finds a broad application area in operations research, stochastic optimization, and reinforcement learning. There are N N independent Markov processes that may be operated, observed and offer rewards.

arxiv-2205-10872.title: Fusion Subspace Clustering for Incomplete Data
arxiv-2205-10872.creator: Usman Mahmood, Daniel Pimentel-Alarcón
arxiv-2205-10872.description: Abstract This paper introduces fusion subspace clustering , a novel method to learn low-dimensional structures that approximate large scale yet highly incomplete data. The main idea is to assign each datum to a subspace of its own, and minimize the distance between the subspaces of all data, so that subspaces of the same cluster get fused together.

arxiv-2304-03911.title: Kernel Selection for Gaussian Process in Cosmology: with Approximate Bayesian Computation Rejection and Nested Sampling
arxiv-2304-03911.creator: Hao Zhang, Yu-Chen Wang, Tong-Jie Zhang, Tingting Zhang
arxiv-2304-03911.description: Abstract Gaussian Process (GP) has gained much attention in cosmology due to its ability to reconstruct cosmological data in a model-independent manner. In this study, we compare two methods for GP kernel selection: Approximate Bayesian Computation (ABC) Rejection and nested sampling.

arxiv-2305-15225.title: SAIL: Search-Augmented Instruction Learning
arxiv-2305-15225.creator: Hongyin Luo Yung-Sung Chuang Yuan Gong Tianhua Zhang, Yoon Kim Xixin Wu Danny Fox Helen Meng James Glass
arxiv-2305-15225.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) have been significantly improved by instruction fine-tuning, but still lack transparency and the ability to utilize up-to-date knowledge and information. In this work, we propose search-augmented instruction learning (SAIL), which grounds the language generation and instruction following abilities on complex search results generated by in-house and external search engines.

arxiv-2409-15028.title: Region Mixup
arxiv-2409-15028.creator: Saptarshi Saha & Utpal Garain
arxiv-2409-15028.description: Abstract This paper introduces a simple extension of mixup ( Zhang et al. 2018 ) data augmentation to enhance generalization in visual recognition tasks. Unlike the vanilla mixup method, which blends entire images, our approach focuses on combining regions from multiple images. 1 Introduction Mixup ( Zhang et al.

arxiv-2507-20931.title: Quasi-invariant states for the action of compact groups
arxiv-2507-20931.creator: Maria Elena Griseta
arxiv-2507-20931.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maria Elena Griseta. We analyze a natural C ∗ C^{*} -algebraic definition of G G -quasi-invariant states for the automorphic action of a compact group G G . We prove that, given a G G -quasi-invariant state with central support, when the action of the group G G commutes with the modular group, its GNS representation is equivalent to that of a G G -invariant state. Mathematics Subject Classification : 46L05, 46L30, 37N20.

arxiv-2511-15431.title: Edge-spectral Turán theorems for color-critical graphs with applications
arxiv-2511-15431.creator: Yongtao Li, Hong Liu, Shengtong Zhang
arxiv-2511-15431.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yongtao Li, Hong Liu, Shengtong Zhang. A classical result of Nosal asserts that every m m -edge graph with spectral radius λ ⁡ ( G ) > m \lambda(G)>\sqrt{m} contains a triangle. A celebrated extension of Nikiforov [ 35 ] states that if G G is an m m -edge graph with λ ⁡ ( G ) > ( 1 − 1 / r ) ​ 2 ​ m \lambda(G)>\sqrt{(1-\nicefrac{{1}}{{r}})2m} , then G G contains a clique K r + 1 K_{r+1} .

europmc-pmc7347613.title: LDHA-mediated ROS generation in chondrocytes is a potential therapeutic target for osteoarthritis.
europmc-pmc7347613.creator: Arra M, Swarnkar G, Ke K, Otero JE, Ying J, Duan X, Maruyama T, Rai MF, O'Keefe RJ, Mbalaviele G, Shen J, Abu-Amer Y.
europmc-pmc7347613.description: The contribution of inflammation to the chronic joint disease osteoarthritis (OA) is unclear, and this lack of clarity is detrimental to efforts to identify therapeutic targets. Here we show that chondrocytes under inflammatory conditions undergo a metabolic shift that is...

pmc-10694147.title: Use of the term “landscape” in sustainable agriculture research: A literature review
pmc-10694147.creator: Anna Pereponova, Gunnar Lischeid, Kathrin Grahmann, Sonoko Dorothea Bellingrath-Kimura, Frank A Ewert
pmc-10694147.description: Finding consensus in definitions of commonly-used terms and concepts is a key requirement to enable cooperations between interdisciplinary scientists and practitioners in inter- or transdisciplinary projects. In research on sustainable agriculture, the term ‘landscape’ is emphasised in particular, being used in studies that range from biogeochemical to socio-economic topics. However, it is normally used in a rather unspecific manner.

pmc-10701977.title: Analysis of factors that promote the participation of patients with chronic diseases in shared decision making on medication: a cross-sectional survey in Hubei Province, China
pmc-10701977.creator: Qijun Hu, Zhanchun Feng, Qiao Zong, Jia Wang, Zehao Zheng, Da Feng
pmc-10701977.description: BackgroundShared decision making (SDM) improves the health status of patients with chronic diseases, especially in the condition of poly-medicated patients. This study aims to find the factors associated with participation of patients with chronic diseases in SDM on medication.MethodsA total of 1,196 patients with chronic diseases were selected in Hubei Province of China using cluster sampling methods.

pmc-11668695.title: The increasing role of the allergist in the management of infusion reactions at the Oncology Infusion Center
pmc-11668695.creator: Julián Borrás Cuartero, Maria Cruz Torres Górriz, Cristina Isabel Stein Coronado, Adrián Germán Sánchez, Cristina Giovanna Pesántez Méndez, Maria Dolores Latorre Ibáñez, Ernesto Enrique
pmc-11668695.description: BackgroundHypersensitivity reactions to chemotherapy disrupt treatment schedules and compromise patient outcomes. Rapid Drug Desensitization (RDD) enables patients to tolerate future treatments after an allergy workup. However, Same-Day Desensitization (SDD) is a novel approach that capitalizes on RDD to allow the continuation of chemotherapy on the same day as the index reaction, preventing treatment delays.

pmc-11711128.title: Bifidobacterium longum RAPO Attenuates Dermal and Pulmonary Fibrosis in a Mouse Model of Systemic Sclerosis through Macrophage Modulation and Growth of Short-Chain Fatty Acid Producers
pmc-11711128.creator: Hee Jin Park, Dakyum Yu, Seong-Tshool Hong, Juyeon Lee, Sang-Jun Park, Myeong Soo Park, Hanna Lee, Mingyo Kim, Yun-Hong Cheon, Seung-Geun Lee, Dong Hyun Sohn, Jae-Bum Jun, Suhee Kim, Sang-Il Lee
pmc-11711128.description: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is a complex autoimmune disease with an unclear etiology and no effective treatments. Recent research has suggested involvement of the microbiome in SSc pathogenesis. This study aimed to identify specific microbial species associated with SSc and explore their therapeutic potential.

pmc-12579422.title: Two-year results of Lenslet-ARray-Integrated spectacle lenses for myopia control in children
pmc-12579422.creator: Binbin Su, Pauline Cho, Stephen J. Vincent, Jingwei Zheng, Jiaojie Chen, Huiling Lin, Feifu Wang, Zihao Sheng, Xueqian Wang, Fan Lu, Jun Jiang
pmc-12579422.description: PurposeTo investigate the 2-year myopia control efficacy of Lenslet-ARray-Integrated (LARI) lenses with positive (PLARI) and negative (NLARI) power lenslets and the effect of switching lens designs.MethodsA total of 218 children, who were randomly assigned to wear PLARI, NLARI, or single-vision (SV) lenses in Phase 1 continued in this randomized, double-masked extended trial for an additional year (Phase 2).

pmc-12609617.title: NDR2 Kinase Regulates Microglial Metabolic Adaptation and Inflammatory Response: Critical Role in Glucose-Dependent Functional Plasticity
pmc-12609617.creator: Beatriz Fazendeiro, Ivo Machado, Anabela Rolo, Paulo Rodrigues Santos, António Francisco Ambrósio, Paulo F. Santos, Hélène Léger
pmc-12609617.description: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), a major complication of diabetes, is driven by chronic inflammation in which retinal microglial cells play a central role. The Hippo pathway kinases NDR1/2 regulate macrophage function, but their role in microglia and DR remain unknown. This study investigates the function of the NDR2 kinase in microglial cells under high-glucose (HG) conditions.

pmc-12658039.title: Analysis and measurement of multi-factor coupling risk in underground coal mine gas explosion based on system dynamics
pmc-12658039.creator: Huimin Guo, Yifan Chen, Lianhua Cheng, Shugang Li
pmc-12658039.description: To investigate the evolutionary mechanism of coal mine gas explosion, and to improve the level of system safety. In this paper, a multi-factor coupled risk deduction model for coal mine gas explosion is constructed by using the system dynamics method. The two subsystems of ‘human factors’ and ‘material factors’ are simulated by using Vensim software.

pmc-12816282.title: Long-term biogas slurry fertilization alters rhizosphere soil metabolite profiles and microbial communities in poplar plantations
pmc-12816282.creator: Xiao-Xiao Gao, Xing-Ye Yu, Chun-Zhi Jin, Long Jin, Su Bu, Taihua Li, Hong-Hua Ruan, Kee-Sun Shin, Feng-Jie Jin
pmc-12816282.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Biogas slurry, a nutrient-rich organic fertilizer, has unclear impacts on plant-soil interactions. Rhizosphere metabolites serve as a bridge between plants and soil microorganisms, significantly influencing soil health and microbial activity. This study employed high-throughput sequencing and untargeted metabolomics to investigate microbial community and metabolite profiles in rhizosphere soil of poplar plantations treated with biogas slurry at different concentrations (Con: untreated; Low: 250 m3 ha−1 yr−1; High: 375 m3 ha−1 yr−1).

pmc-13214456.title: The effectiveness of gender-neutral HPV vaccination programmes in preventing HPV-associated oral cancers: a systematic review
pmc-13214456.creator: Lamia M Douyat, Angela Spencer
pmc-13214456.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHuman papillomavirus infections are a significant risk factor for the development of oral cancers. While HPV vaccines have proven effective in preventing cervical cancers, their impact on oral cancers remains insufficiently examined.

pmc-13415578.title: Spatiotemporal orchestration of the salivary gland immune microenvironment in Sjögren’s disease: a multidimensional framework of epithelial licensing, lymphoid neogenesis, and stromal remodeling
pmc-13415578.creator: Shouze Ren, Qiwei Li, Rui Niu, Xixi Liu, Peng Zhou, Xiadong Yang, Hua Liang
pmc-13415578.description: Sjögren’s disease (SjD) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by lymphocytic infiltration of the exocrine glands and progressive secretory dysfunction. Although the major molecular abnormalities in SjD, including prominent type I interferon activation and abnormal B-cell responses, are now better defined, these findings have not consistently translated into effective disease-modifying therapy.

pmc-13537902.title: Musashi‐1 Drives Radioresistance and Stemness in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma via a Radioresistant FaDu Model
pmc-13537902.creator: Na‐Eun Kang, Chan‐Woong Jung, Yun‐Ju Kim, Sung‐Gil Chi, Jeong‐Yub Kim, Myung‐Jin Park
pmc-13537902.description: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is frequently managed with radiotherapy, but the emergence of radioresistant cancer cells with cancer stem cell (CSC) properties remains a major clinical obstacle. Here, we established a radioresistant FaDu cell line (F‐IRR) by repeated fractionated irradiation to investigate the molecular basis of radiation resistance in HNSCC.
